classificationDefinitions.ENFORCED: an executable artefact proves it (test, verifier script, migration, policy or machine-checked contract match) and, where a boundary is declared, a real call site invokes it
classificationDefinitions.DECLARED: a module, document or contract mentions it, but nothing executable proves it
classificationDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED: implementation and tests exist, but the declared boundary patterns match nothing — the capability protects nothing yet

ownership.note: Phase 24 owns tokens, component contracts, accessibility standards, personalization and experience governance. Domain content, authorization and the human interface layer remain owned by consuming or adjacent phases.

areas.area: Design tokens, themes and density are coherent
areas.requirement: Tokens can be created and deprecated with replacements; light/dark/high-contrast palettes and density modes resolve from governed inputs.

areas.area: Accessibility, motion and honest empty states are explicit
areas.requirement: AA/AAA systems, contrast checks, reduced motion, visible focus/touch defaults and actionable or explicit empty states are represented.
Role, device and experience-level personalization changes presentation only, filters unauthorized commands and reports denied dimensions instead of widening access.

areas.area: AI and interaction states are attributable and safe
areas.requirement: AI messages and approvals, notifications, onboarding, loading, error and offline experience states are explicit and do not present generated content as an official record.

areas.area: Experience quality, telemetry and release gates are governed
areas.requirement: Telemetry is anonymized, experiments validate weights, SLOs distinguish healthy/breached, required release checks block failures and visual QA reports blockers.

areas.area: Shared experience contracts remain partly unwired
areas.requirement: Consuming runtime surfaces must resolve these contracts without owning authorization or domain content; current evidence proves the engines and tests, not universal consumption.

limitations: Classification measures the presence of executable evidence, not the correctness or completeness of that evidence.
A DECLARED area is unfinished work, never a false claim — it is reported as such.
An IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED area has a tested implementation that no boundary calls; it is reported, never counted as enforcement.
Evidence patterns are declared per phase in architecture/phase-acceptance/phase-<id>-*.json and must be reviewed when a phase is re-audited.
